abstract: ai-ready is a Claude Code plugin, published from this repo's marketplace, that makes repositories AI ready. It maps a repo's components, prunes stale docs and keeps CLAUDE.md lean. A single stdlib Python checker then enforces that state from Claude Code hooks, slash commands, a GitHub Action and a pre-commit hook. A benchmark measures what the skill saves in tokens.

components.name: plugin
components.responsibility: The plugin: the ai_ready_check.py checker, the make-ai-ready skill, the /ai-ready:check and /ai-ready:explain commands, the factory (/ai-ready:plan, /ai-ready:build, /ai-ready:status, the .ai-ready/work tracker and the planner, coder, tester and documenter agents), and the hooks.

components.name: integrations
components.responsibility: Ways to run the checker outside Claude Code: the composite GitHub Action, .pre-commit-hooks.yaml, and this repo's CI workflow, which runs the tests and the self-check.

components.name: benchmark
components.responsibility: Before/after token and cost benchmark of the skill on a target repo, with recorded results.
